description.value:
You add Glyph of Warding to your spellbook and it doesn't count against the number of prepared spells for you. You can replace the material component of the spell with a use of one of your runes.

Additionally, you can also choose objects you or someone else is wearing as valid targets for the spell. If you do so, you cannot choose the Spell Glyph option of the spell.

You can place only one glyph in this manner and if you place a new one in this manner, the first one disappears.

Additionally, when you cast Glyph of Warding, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier. The chosen creatures are exempt from the Glyph's effect when it is triggered.
